Messages.Author: Marlo Tacla
Messages.Body:
Greetings Wise Elders,

Could any of you please clarify me these stupid doubts?

1) Can I use damage prevention cards at any time? If so, can I use Skin
of Rock AFTER Flesh of Marble to prevent the single point of damage that
the Flesh doesn't prevent?

2) I have just finish reading (again) the rule book, and it states very
clearly that a minion cannot use directed bleed cards (like Legal
Manipulations, or Computer Hacking) to bleed other Mathuselah than its
controller prey. Is this correct? I am asking because I've seen in some
place something stating otherwise (some link on the errata)

3) Is the effect of Gangrel Revel cumulative?

Tks a lot.

Marlo

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 21 Jan 2000, Marlo Tacla wrote:
> 1) Can I use damage prevention cards at any time? If so, can I use Skin
> of Rock AFTER Flesh of Marble to prevent the single point of damage that
> the Flesh doesn't prevent?

No. The Flesh of Marble prevents damage that was not otherwise prevented
- requiring you to relinquish your right to prevent that 1 point.

> 2) I have just finish reading (again) the rule book, and it states very
> clearly that a minion cannot use directed bleed cards (like Legal
> Manipulations, or Computer Hacking) to bleed other Mathuselah than its
> controller prey. Is this correct? I am asking because I've seen in some
> place something stating otherwise (some link on the errata)

At one point, the Rules Team said you could bleed other people. That
ruling was overturned.

Now, unless a card says (D) Bleed your predator or whatever, you can't do
it (see, for example, Cat Burglary, Night Moves or Rafael Giovanni).

> 3) Is the effect of Gangrel Revel cumulative?

Yes.

--

James Coupe
